title: Manatee account distinguishes rated capacity from operating evidence
summary: The existing Manatee Atlas account gains six sections and five dated events from five primary HTML records and scoped PDF text. The July monthly-evidence decision remains visible with its original date and Partially Closed status.
evidence_note: The 409 MW / 900 MWh ratings, nameplate-duration arithmetic, retirement proposal and later winter-peaking qualification retain separate meanings. Lansing Smith is a different asset. The current EIA index was inspected, not its linked ZIP; no later monthly values or interval availability are admitted. PDF images were not inspected, and the 2025 staff-response retrieval timed out.
publication_effect: Local source integration only; production rendering, release and launch remain unverified.
